about: Paul's drawn sky flow (2026-11-10, docs/shots/sky-river-paul.webp): 7 polylines in canvas uv (u right, v UP, the canvas-camera convention), each ordered in the flow direction, the river's order 1 to 7. Registered onto the scan by NCC 0.86: scan px = -13 + 0.669 x his px and 36 + 0.669 y his px on the 1024 x 811 frame.webp, then canvas uv past its 12 px and 4 px mat inset. Read by src/motion/sky-river.ts; the bake ignores it. A path's optional sigmaDeg narrows its reach in the guide blend (default SKY_RIVER_GUIDE_SIGMA): the loop round the small right swirl reaches 1.5 degrees, so the horizon band under it keeps the river's left-to-right flow.

paths.note: 1 upper left, down-right then right above the cypress
2 from the cypress up-right along the band over the big swirl
3 the big swirl's outer right lobe, down its right side and curling left at the bottom
4 the inner left lobe, hooking over its top going left
5 down the inner lobe's left side
6 out along the bottom of the big swirl, right into the small right swirl
7 round the small right swirl, clockwise
